load_cfg: load a pycls config from a YAML file into the global cfg object
dump_cfg: dump the current pycls config to a YAML file in the output directory
reset_cfg: reset the pycls config back to its default frozen state
assert_cfg: validate the pycls config values and check invariants like batch size and data splits
configure_model: set pycls model options like TYPE, DEPTH, NUM_CLASSES, LOSS_FUN, and ACTIVATION_FUN on cfg.MODEL
